verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own workflow automation, triggered by events such as a deal closing, with field updates as an action. Record inserts can trigger workflows unless explicitly suppressed, and Zia can create workflows. However, the pack shows no task-creation or notification actions within workflows. The notifications API is a developer change-feed, not a workflow action, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented workflow actions for creating tasks and sending notifications, detail on trigger types and conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Automate repetitive tasks with workflows. From routing leads to the right rep to updating fields when a deal is closed.
Enter the trigger value as [] to not execute the workflows.
Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds
